name: docker-laravel-astro
description: Docker starter for a headless Laravel (Breeze/Sanctum) backend + Astro frontend, with optional Caddy reverse-proxy mode.
author: Ken Eucker <keneucker@gmail.com>

scripts.dev:localhost: npm run env:localhost && npm run dc:down && npm run dc:up
scripts.dev:proxy: npm run env:proxy && npm run dc:down && docker compose --profile proxy up -d --build
scripts.env:localhost: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path='.env';if(!fs.existsSync(path))throw new Error('No .env file found');const keys=['APP_URL','PUBLIC_API_URL','FRONTEND_URL','PUBLIC_SITE_URL','ADMIN_HOSTNAME','INTRANET_HOSTNAME','SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS','SESSION_DOMAIN','SESSION_DRIVER'];const lines=fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);const out=lines.map(l=>{const m=l.match(/^([^#=]+)=/);if(!m)return l;const k=m[1];if(keys.includes(k))return '# '+l.replace(/^#+\s*/,'');return l;});fs.writeFileSync(path,out.join('\n'));console.log('✔ env:localhost → commented proxy/domain-related keys');"
scripts.env:proxy: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path='.env';if(!fs.existsSync(path))throw new Error('No .env file found');const required={SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS:'intranet.local.test,admin.local.test',SESSION_DOMAIN:'local.test',SESSION_DRIVER:'file'};let lines=fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);const seen=new Set();lines=lines.map(l=>{const raw=l.replace(/^#+\s*/,'');const m=raw.match(/^([^=]+)=(.*)$/);if(!m)return l;const k=m[1];if(required[k]){seen.add(k);return `${k}=${required[k]}`;}return raw;});for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(required)){if(!seen.has(k))lines.push(`${k}=${v}`);}fs.writeFileSync(path,lines.join('\n'));console.log('✔ env:proxy → enabled proxy/domain settings');"
